title: けものミチ
description:
Kekmonomichi" is a command action RPG.Receive requests and search.The main character receives requests from the people of the city as a detective.
The game progresses by fulfilling the requests.
Command Action Battle.In this title, simple action commands are performed when attacking or defending.
If successful, you can increase the damage you inflict or avoid enemy attacks.
Preparation for search.Before going on a search, you can eat a dish to give you an advantage in your search.
Eat the food to get the best out of your search.

In this title, items can be made from materials obtained during the search.
You can also buy items from peddlers, but if you have the materials, you can make a variety of items.
Redecorate your room.You can redecorate the rooms that serve as your base.
For a change of scenery!
